# Check sequencing depth of gut samples
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)

depths <- data.frame(
  Sample = sample_names(ps_gut_clean),
  Reads = sample_sums(ps_gut_clean),
  Condition = sample_data(ps_gut_clean)$Condition
)

depths %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    min = min(Reads),
    Q1 = quantile(Reads, 0.25),
    median = median(Reads),
    mean = mean(Reads),
    max = max(Reads),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary(depths$Reads)
```

# Sequencing depth by site
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

depth_richness <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(comm_asv),
  Condition = sample_data(ps_gut_clean)$Condition[
    match(rownames(comm_asv), sample_names(ps_gut_clean))
  ],
  Reads_ASV = rowSums(comm_asv),
  Observed_ASV = rowSums(comm_asv > 0),
  Reads_Genus = rowSums(comm_genus),
  Observed_Genus = rowSums(comm_genus > 0)
)

depth_richness$Condition <- factor(
  depth_richness$Condition,
  levels = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2")
)

# Summary statistics
depth_richness %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    min = min(Reads_ASV),
    Q1 = quantile(Reads_ASV, 0.25),
    median = median(Reads_ASV),
    mean = mean(Reads_ASV),
    max = max(Reads_ASV),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ANOVA
aov_depth <- aov(Reads_ASV ~ Condition, data = depth_richness)
summary(aov_depth)

# Levene's test
car::leveneTest(Reads_ASV ~ Condition, data = depth_richness)

# Does not statistically differ between sites
```

# Box plot
```{r}
depth_plot <- ggplot(
  depth_richness,
  aes(x = Condition, y = Reads_ASV)
) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Condition, colour = Condition)) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(fill = Condition, colour = Condition),
    shape = 21,
    width = 0.1,
    size = 2.5,
    alpha = 0.8,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = disp.pal1,
    labels = c("Reference", expression("Elevated CO"[2]))
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = disp.pal2,
    labels = c("Reference", expression("Elevated CO"[2]))
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    name = "Site",
    labels = c("Reference", expression("Elevated CO"[2]))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Sequencing depth (reads)",
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

depth_plot
```

# Sequencing depth versus observed richness
```{r}
# Convert to long format
richness_depth_long <- depth_richness %>%
  select(
    Condition,
    Reads_ASV,
    Observed_ASV,
    Reads_Genus,
    Observed_Genus
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Condition,
    names_to = c(".value", "Taxonomic_level"),
    names_pattern = "(Reads|Observed)_(ASV|Genus)"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Reads = Reads,
    Richness = Observed
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Taxonomic_level = factor(
      Taxonomic_level,
      levels = c("ASV", "Genus")
    )
  )

# Plot
richness_depth_plot <- ggplot(
  richness_depth_long,
  aes(x = Reads, y = Richness, colour = Condition)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = Condition),
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = disp.pal2,
    labels = c("Reference", expression("Elevated CO"[2]))
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~Taxonomic_level,
    scales = "free",
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Sequencing depth (reads)",
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Observed richness",
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 1
    ),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

richness_depth_plot
```

```{r}
model_asv <- lm(
  Observed_ASV ~ Reads_ASV * Condition,
  data = depth_richness
)

summary(model_asv)

# Genus-level

  Observed_Genus ~ Reads_Genus * Condition,
```

# Check rarefaction curves
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Convert phyloseq objects to sample x taxa matrices
# --------------------------------------------------

get_comm <- function(ps) {

  otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")

  if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
    otu <- t(otu)
  }

  otu
}

# ASV-level community matrix
comm_asv <- get_comm(ps_gut_clean)

# Genus-level community matrix
ps_genus <- tax_glom(
  ps_gut_clean,
  taxrank = "Genus",
  NArm = TRUE
)

comm_genus <- get_comm(ps_genus)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Rarefaction curves
# --------------------------------------------------

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

rarecurve(
  comm_asv,
  step = 5000,
  sample = 74184,
  label = FALSE,
  xlab = "Sequencing depth",
  ylab = "Observed ASV richness",
  main = "ASV richness"
)

rarecurve(
  comm_genus,
  step = 5000,
  sample = 74184,
  label = FALSE,
  xlab = "Sequencing depth",
  ylab = "Observed genus richness",
  main = "Genus richness"
)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

# Old
# Alpha Diversity Plots
```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# conflicts with phyloseq
unloadNamespace("philr")
unloadNamespace("ggtree")
unloadNamespace("treeio")
unloadNamespace("tidytree")

sample_data(ps_gut_clean)
alpha_diversity <- estimate_richness(tax_glom(ps_gut_clean, taxrank = "Genus"), measure = c("Shannon", "Observed"))
names(alpha_diversity)[names(alpha_diversity) == "Observed"] <- "Richness"
names(alpha_diversity)[names(alpha_diversity) == "Shannon"] <- "Diversity"
alpha_diversity$Evenness <- alpha_diversity$Diversity / log(alpha_diversity$Richness)
alpha_diversity <- data.frame(alpha_diversity, sample_data(ps_gut_clean))

alpha_long <- alpha_diversity %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Diversity, Richness, Evenness),
               names_to = "Measure", values_to = "Value") %>%
mutate(Site = factor(Condition, levels = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2")))

# --- Pivot and recode alpha diversity ---
alpha_long <- alpha_diversity %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Diversity, Richness, Evenness),
    names_to = "Measure",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Site = factor(Condition,
      levels = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2")
    )
  )

# Map old names to final facet labels
measure_labels <- c(
  "Evenness" = "Evenness",
  "Richness" = "Richness",
  "Diversity" = "Shannon"
)

# Apply mapping and set factor levels
alpha_long$Measure <- factor(measure_labels[alpha_long$Measure],
                             levels = c("Evenness", "Richness", "Shannon"))

# --- Plot ---
disp.pal1 <- c("#2C728E", "#D4476C") 
disp.pal2 <- c("#1F4E64", "#9B3654")

library(ggpubr)

# Significance based on ANOVA (chunk below)
sig_df <- data.frame(
  Measure = c("Evenness", "Shannon"),
  group1 = c("Reference", "Reference"),
  group2 = c("Elevated CO2", "Elevated CO2"),
  y.position = c(0.47, 2.4),
  label = c("**", "**")
)

combined_alpha_plots <- ggplot(alpha_long, aes(x = Site, y = Value)) + 
  stat_boxplot(aes(colour = Site), geom = 'errorbar', alpha = 1) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Site, colour = Site)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(fill = Site, colour = Site),
              shape = 21, width = 0.1, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8,
              show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point",
               shape = 23, size = 2.5, colour = "black", fill = "white",
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = disp.pal1,
                    labels = c("Reference", expression("Elevated CO"[2]))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = disp.pal2,
                      labels = c("Reference", expression("Elevated CO"[2]))) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Site",
                   labels = c("Reference", expression("Elevated CO"[2]))) +
  scale_y_continuous(
  name = "Alpha Diversity Measure",
  breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.5, 0.5))
) +
  facet_wrap(~Measure, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    sig_df,
    label = "label",
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    tip.length = 0.01,
    bracket.size = 0.5
  ) + theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) 


# --- Show plot ---
combined_alpha_plots

# --- Save plot ---
ggsave("Figures_Alpha_Beta_div/combined_alpha_plots_clean.svg", combined_alpha_plots,
       width = 23, height = 12, units = "cm", dpi = 900)
```

#Stats
```{r}
library(car)

leveneTest(Richness ~ Condition, data = alpha_diversity) #NS = assumptions met
anov_richness_tissue <- aov(Richness ~ Condition, data = alpha_diversity) 
summary(anov_richness_tissue)
#p adj ns

leveneTest(Evenness ~ Condition, data = alpha_diversity) #NS = assumptions met
anov_evenness_tissue <- aov(Evenness ~ Condition, data = alpha_diversity)
summary(anov_evenness_tissue)
# p adj = 0.00317 **

leveneTest(Diversity ~ Condition, data = alpha_diversity) #NS = assumptions met
anov_shannon_tissue <- aov(Diversity ~ Condition, data = alpha_diversity)
summary(anov_shannon_tissue)
# p adj 0.00492 **

# No differences in gut community Richness
# Higher Evenness and Shannon Diversity in Elevated CO2

par(mfrow = c(1,3))

qqnorm(residuals(anov_richness_tissue))
qqline(residuals(anov_richness_tissue))

qqnorm(residuals(anov_evenness_tissue))
qqline(residuals(anov_evenness_tissue))

qqnorm(residuals(anov_shannon_tissue))
qqline(residuals(anov_shannon_tissue))

par(mfrow = c(1,1))

```




# Updated following reviewer comments
```{r}
rarefaction_depth <- min(sample_sums(ps_gut_clean))
rarefaction_depth

# Alpha diversity: ASV and genus levels

library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Community matrices
# --------------------------------------------------

get_comm <- function(ps) {

  otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")

  if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
    otu <- t(otu)
  }

  otu
}

# ASV-level
comm_asv <- get_comm(ps_gut_clean)

# Genus-level
ps_genus <- tax_glom(
  ps_gut_clean,
  taxrank = "Genus",
  NArm = TRUE
)

comm_genus <- get_comm(ps_genus)


# --------------------------------------------------
# Richness: rarefied to common sequencing depth
# --------------------------------------------------

rarefaction_depth <- min(
  min(rowSums(comm_asv)),
  min(rowSums(comm_genus))
)

richness_asv <- vegan::rarefy(
  comm_asv,
  sample = rarefaction_depth
)

richness_genus <- vegan::rarefy(
  comm_genus,
  sample = rarefaction_depth
)


# --------------------------------------------------
# Evenness: Smith-Wilson Evar
# --------------------------------------------------

calculate_evar <- function(x) {

  x <- x[x > 0]

  if (length(x) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  1 - (2 / pi) * atan(var(log(x)))
}

evenness_asv <- apply(comm_asv, 1, calculate_evar)

evenness_genus <- apply(comm_genus, 1, calculate_evar)


# --------------------------------------------------
# Combine metrics and metadata
# --------------------------------------------------

alpha_diversity <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(comm_asv),
  Richness_ASV = as.numeric(richness_asv),
  Richness_Genus = as.numeric(richness_genus),
  Evenness_ASV = as.numeric(evenness_asv),
  Evenness_Genus = as.numeric(evenness_genus)
) %>%
  left_join(
    data.frame(sample_data(ps_gut_clean)) %>%
      rownames_to_column("Sample"),
    by = "Sample"
  )
```

# Check if rarefaction solved the sequencing-depth induced richness bias
```{r}
depth_richness_asv <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(comm_asv),
  Reads_ASV = rowSums(comm_asv),
  Observed_ASV = rowSums(comm_asv > 0),
  Rarefied_ASV = as.numeric(richness_asv)
) %>%
  left_join(
    data.frame(sample_data(ps_gut_clean)) %>%
      rownames_to_column("Sample"),
    by = "Sample"
  )


ggplot(
  depth_richness_asv,
  aes(x = Reads_ASV, y = Rarefied_ASV, colour = Condition)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = Condition),
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = disp.pal2,
    labels = c("Reference", expression("Elevated CO"[2]))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Original sequencing depth (reads)",
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Expected ASV richness (rarefied)",
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 1
    ),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

depth_richness_asv <- depth_richness_asv %>%
  mutate(
    Reads_c = Reads_ASV - mean(Reads_ASV)
  )

model_rarefied_asv <- lm(
  Rarefied_ASV ~ Reads_c * Condition,
  data = depth_richness_asv
)

summary(model_rarefied_asv)

anova(model_rarefied_asv)
```

# Trying with unrarefied data
```{r}

# ============================================================
# ALPHA DIVERSITY: UNRAREFIED ASV- AND GENUS-LEVEL DATA
# ============================================================

library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(car)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Community matrices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

get_comm_unrare <- function(ps) {

  otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")

  if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
    otu <- t(otu)
  }

  otu
}

# ASV-level: original, unrarefied data
comm_asv_unrare <- get_comm_unrare(ps_gut_clean)

# Genus-level: original counts aggregated by genus
ps_genus_unrare <- tax_glom(
  ps_gut_clean,
  taxrank = "Genus",
  NArm = TRUE
)

comm_genus_unrare <- get_comm_unrare(ps_genus_unrare)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Richness: observed taxa (no rarefaction)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

richness_asv_unrare <- rowSums(comm_asv_unrare > 0)

richness_genus_unrare <- rowSums(comm_genus_unrare > 0)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Evenness: Smith-Wilson Evar
# ------------------------------------------------------------

calculate_evar_unrare <- function(x) {

  x <- x[x > 0]

  if (length(x) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  1 - (2 / pi) * atan(var(log(x)))
}

evenness_asv_unrare <- apply(
  comm_asv_unrare,
  1,
  calculate_evar_unrare
)

evenness_genus_unrare <- apply(
  comm_genus_unrare,
  1,
  calculate_evar_unrare
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine metrics and metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------

alpha_diversity_unrare <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(comm_asv_unrare),
  Richness_ASV_unrare = as.numeric(richness_asv_unrare),
  Richness_Genus_unrare = as.numeric(richness_genus_unrare),
  Evenness_ASV_unrare = as.numeric(evenness_asv_unrare),
  Evenness_Genus_unrare = as.numeric(evenness_genus_unrare)
) %>%
  left_join(
    data.frame(sample_data(ps_gut_clean)) %>%
      rownames_to_column("Sample"),
    by = "Sample"
  ) %>%
  select(
    Sample,
    Condition,
    Richness_ASV_unrare,
    Evenness_ASV_unrare,
    Richness_Genus_unrare,
    Evenness_Genus_unrare
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Long format for plotting
# ------------------------------------------------------------

alpha_long_unrare <- alpha_diversity_unrare %>%
  select(
    Condition,
    Richness_ASV_unrare,
    Evenness_ASV_unrare,
    Richness_Genus_unrare,
    Evenness_Genus_unrare
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Condition,
    names_to = "Measure",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Site = factor(
      Condition,
      levels = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2")
    ),
    Measure = factor(
      Measure,
      levels = c(
        "Richness_ASV_unrare",
        "Evenness_ASV_unrare",
        "Richness_Genus_unrare",
        "Evenness_Genus_unrare"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "ASV-level richness",
        "ASV-level evenness",
        "Genus-level richness",
        "Genus-level evenness"
      )
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Statistical tests: Levene's tests and ANOVAs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# ASV richness
levene_asv_richness_unrare <- leveneTest(
  Richness_ASV_unrare ~ Condition,
  data = alpha_diversity_unrare
)

anova_asv_richness_unrare <- aov(
  Richness_ASV_unrare ~ Condition,
  data = alpha_diversity_unrare
)

summary(anova_asv_richness_unrare)


# ASV evenness
levene_asv_evenness_unrare <- leveneTest(
  Evenness_ASV_unrare ~ Condition,
  data = alpha_diversity_unrare
)

anova_asv_evenness_unrare <- aov(
  Evenness_ASV_unrare ~ Condition,
  data = alpha_diversity_unrare
)

summary(anova_asv_evenness_unrare)


# Genus richness
levene_genus_richness_unrare <- leveneTest(
  Richness_Genus_unrare ~ Condition,
  data = alpha_diversity_unrare
)

anova_genus_richness_unrare <- aov(
  Richness_Genus_unrare ~ Condition,
  data = alpha_diversity_unrare
)

summary(anova_genus_richness_unrare)


# Genus evenness
levene_genus_evenness_unrare <- leveneTest(
  Evenness_Genus_unrare ~ Condition,
  data = alpha_diversity_unrare
)

anova_genus_evenness_unrare <- aov(
  Evenness_Genus_unrare ~ Condition,
  data = alpha_diversity_unrare
)

summary(anova_genus_evenness_unrare)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Collect ANOVA results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

anova_results_unrare <- data.frame(
  Measure = c(
    "ASV-level richness",
    "ASV-level evenness",
    "Genus-level richness",
    "Genus-level evenness"
  ),
  p_value = c(
    summary(anova_asv_richness_unrare)[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1],
    summary(anova_asv_evenness_unrare)[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1],
    summary(anova_genus_richness_unrare)[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1],
    summary(anova_genus_evenness_unrare)[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]
  )
)

anova_results_unrare


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Significance labels for figure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

alpha_y_positions_unrare <- alpha_long_unrare %>%
  group_by(Measure) %>%
  summarise(
    y.position = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sig_df_unrare <- anova_results_unrare %>%
  left_join(alpha_y_positions_unrare, by = "Measure") %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = "Reference",
    group2 = "Elevated CO2",
    label = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    )
  )

sig_df_unrare


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

alpha_long_unrare$Measure <- factor(
  alpha_long_unrare$Measure,
  levels = c(
    "ASV-level richness",
    "ASV-level evenness",
    "Genus-level richness",
    "Genus-level evenness"
  )
)

combined_alpha_plots_unrare <- ggplot(
  alpha_long_unrare,
  aes(x = Site, y = Value)
) +

  stat_boxplot(
    aes(colour = Site),
    geom = "errorbar",
    alpha = 1
  ) +

  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Site, colour = Site)
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    aes(fill = Site, colour = Site),
    shape = 21,
    width = 0.1,
    size = 2.5,
    alpha = 0.8,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size = 2.5,
    colour = "black",
    fill = "white",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = disp.pal1,
    labels = c("Reference", expression("Elevated CO"[2]))
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = disp.pal2,
    labels = c("Reference", expression("Elevated CO"[2]))
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    name = "Site",
    labels = c("Reference", expression("Elevated CO"[2]))
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Alpha Diversity Measure",
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20))
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~Measure,
    scales = "free",
    ncol = 4,
    dir = "h",
    as.table = TRUE
  ) +

  stat_pvalue_manual(
    sig_df_unrare,
    label = "label",
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    tip.length = 0.01,
    bracket.size = 0.5
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )


# Display figure
combined_alpha_plots_unrare


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save figure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  "Figures_Alpha_Beta_div/Updated_combined_alpha_plots_UNRAREFIED.svg",
  combined_alpha_plots_unrare,
  width = 24,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 900
)
```
